name: We Come Hostel
detail: I had planned to be mostly outside while traveling alone, so I hoped to find an inexpensive dormitory. However, this accommodation turned out to have impeccable facilities, clean beds, a comfortable shared space, and very friendly staff, all of which were truly wonderful. The location is also close to Dihua Street and Taipei Main Station, with three craft beer bars just a short walk away and a night market nearby. I would like to use this place again next time.

name: York Design Hotel
detail: I stayed with a female friend. It’s located on a street with many restaurants and shops, and it was a bit difficult to find the entrance at first, wondering if there was even a hotel. However, we discovered the building entrance between a restaurant right in front of Sukiya! They also took care of our luggage both before and after check-in, allowing us to enjoy a lot of sightseeing. There is no bath, only a shower room. Body soap and a rinse-in shampoo were provided. There was a notice asking not to flush the toilet paper. We couldn’t hear the voices from the neighboring rooms. (The door is extremely heavy) The room decor was very clean, and I was satisfied!
area: Taipei Main Station,Taipei - View on map

name: HOTEL CHAM CHAM - Taipei
detail: Room Clean, with a large bathroom mirror, and the toilet and bath are separate It has large windows with a nice view There are no amenities, so please bring your own Location Less than a 5-minute walk from MRT Banqiao Surrounded by many department stores The food court inside the station is well-stocked, and the Mega City department store has famous restaurants like Din Tai Fung, making it enjoyable There aren't many breakfast places nearby, so you'll need to either walk a bit to eat or rely on convenience stores Some may think that Banqiao is far and avoid it, but it takes about 10 minutes to get to Taipei Station by MRT I think staying at this class of hotel in Ximen or Zhongshan would cost three times as much.

name: Park City Inn & Hostel - Yonghe Taipei
detail: The staff was kind, and they readily accepted to store our luggage after checkout. The breakfast was appealing, and although we only had one ticket, we ended up visiting two eligible places. The room was great considering the price, and I was happy with the ample storage. Thank you very much.

name: Park Taipei Hotel
detail: I have been to Taiwan several times, but each time I stayed around Ximending. This time, since I was traveling with my child, I wanted to find a quieter neighborhood. Even though my child is preschool-aged, it was uncomfortable for all three of us to sleep in a double bed, so I looked for a place with a queen-size bed or larger. Here, we had a king-size bed, and we slept very comfortably! The location was great, right next to the MRT, and there was a bus stop nearby, making it easy to get around! Since the place was a bit older, the bathroom was a little disappointing (it had a bit of an odor), but when we mentioned that we needed more towels, they quickly provided them, and the cleaning was very thorough! There was also a bathtub, which my child loved. The staff were very friendly too! If I come again with my family, I would love to stay here!

name: Just Live Hostel
detail: This is my first solo trip, and I've come to this hostel. The attitude of the front desk staff is very good and friendly. The atmosphere of the entire place is great; you won't feel scared or uneasy. In the evening, other travelers are sitting in the lounge, wearing headphones and watching movies, so it won't disturb each other. Waiting for laundry in the lounge isn't scary either. As for the bathroom, the floor is very clean, and every time I take a shower, the floor is dry. There is also a place provided for makeup. Next door is a McDonald's, and it's only a five-minute walk from Taipei Station. Highly recommended!
area: Taipei Main Station,Taipei - View on map

name: TWIN STAR INN
detail: The location is definitely the best point, as you can enter right inside without going outside after taking the airport train. It is newly built, so the interior is clean, and there is a coin laundry next to the shower room. The refrigerator is large and works well. Water, tea, and coffee were well prepared. However, the signs for the shower room and restroom were hard to recognize, so it would be nice to show the location of the facilities with images during check-in. The coin laundry was affordable, but since they don't exchange coins, please bring $10 in coins if you plan to use it. Again, the location and facilities were really good. I would like to use it again if the price doesn’t exceed 60,000-70,000 won on weekends!
area: Taipei Main Station,Taipei - View on map

name: Dolamanco Hotel
detail: This hotel is located in front of Da'an Park Station. The bedding is clean and the rooms are relatively spacious. I was very satisfied with the table with a mirror and the bar table in front of the window. It is a bit far from Ximending, Dihua Street, and Taipei Station, but it is a sufficient distance that can be easily traveled by metro, so it was fine. Being in front of the park made it great for running and walking in the morning and evening, and the nearby shops were small and tasty, which I liked. The bathroom has an old feeling, but the water pressure was strong and hot water came out immediately, so I was satisfied. The front desk staff was also kind, and I would like to stay at this hotel again next time!

name: Poshpacker Hotel
detail: It is within walking distance to Ximen, and the room was cleaner than I expected. There was water and snacks available. The shower and toilet were also kept clean. I didn't feel any noise and was able to sleep soundly. The front staff were very kind, and they took care of my luggage after checkout with great attention. I'm very happy that there is a female-only building. I would like to stay again.
area: Taipei Main Station,Taipei - View on map

name: Taipei Fullerton Hotel - South
detail: I stayed for three nights this time. It is about a 3-minute walk from Da'an MRT Station, making it very convenient if you use the MRT. Also, it is very close, just four stations, from Songshan Airport without any transfers. The room is adequately spacious, and the bathtub and shower are separated, making it easy to use. There’s a kettle, and two bottles of mineral water are provided daily, along with coffee and tea. The TV has NHK available. It would have been perfect if there was a shower toilet. Breakfast had just the minimum essentials. There was a coffee machine in the lobby that guests could use freely, and it would have been nice if there was one in the breakfast restaurant as well. There is a small gym and sauna on the top floor, but I couldn't use them as the hours of operation didn’t align with my schedule. It would be great if they opened during the late-night hours. The staff are kind, but it seems they don't volunteer information unless asked. During check-in, I was only given an explanation about breakfast, and it would have been better if they provided a bit more information. However, they do answer any questions you ask. There are some places to eat nearby. I think it is a convenient hotel if you are using Songshan Airport or the MRT.
